bead.title: claude-tui: scaffold package, extract anthropic neutral helpers, wire dispatcher
bead.description:
PROBLEM: No claude-tui harness package exists. CONTRACT-004 mandates a neutral shared package (internal/harnesses/anthropic/) that both claude and claude-tui import, with neither importing the other; the dispatcher must recognize the new harness with zero other service-side changes.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claude/ currently owns shared Anthropic-CLI helpers (ModelSnapshot types, billing-observation primitives, output parsers) that claude-tui will need; CONTRACT-004 forbids claude-tui from importing claude or vice versa.
- internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go has no case for harness="claude-tui".
- internal/build/harnessimports lint rule has no awareness of the new package and would not catch a future service*.go leak.
- Harness registry has no claude-tui entry, so even a stub would not be discoverable.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Create internal/harnesses/anthropic/ neutral package. Move shared types (ModelSnapshot, billing-observation primitives, CLI output parsers) out of internal/harnesses/claude/ into anthropic/. Update claude/ imports. Forbid anthropic/ from importing either claude or claude-tui.
2. Create internal/harnesses/claude-tui/ skeleton package: type Harness struct with stub methods returning a sentinel ErrNotYetImplemented; assert at compile time it satisfies harnesses.Harness, harnesses.QuotaHarness, harnesses.AccountHarness, harnesses.ModelDiscoveryHarness via var _ T = (*Harness)(nil).
3. Register claude-tui in the harness registry with empty BaseArgs, empty PermissionArgs, empty ModelFlag, empty ReasoningFlag, empty WorkDirFlag, IsSubscription=true, AutoRoutingEligible=false.
4. Add the claude-tui case to internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go; touch no other service-side file.
5. Update internal/build/harnessimports to include claude-tui in its allow-list rules.

NON-SCOPE:
- Real PTY-driven turn execution and intermediate ProgressEvents (child #2).
- Live ModelDiscoveryHarness snapshot and no-static-fallback enforcement (child #3).
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 promotion (child #4).
- Service-side changes beyond the single dispatcher case.
- Modifying existing claude harness behavior beyond import path updates.
- Cross-importing claude<->claude-tui (forbidden by CONTRACT-004).

Governing artifacts: ADR-013, CONTRACT-004, AR-2026-05-17-repo, plan-2026-05-14-harness-interface-refactor.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiInterfaceConformance asserts (*claudetui.Harness)(nil) satisfies harnesses.Harness, harnesses.QuotaHarness, harnesses.AccountHarness, and harnesses.ModelDiscoveryHarness via compile-time var _ assertions.
2) TestAnthropicNeutralPackageBoundary uses a static import check to assert internal/harnesses/claude does not import internal/harnesses/claude-tui, claude-tui does not import claude, both import internal/harnesses/anthropic, and anthropic imports neither.
3) TestDispatcherRecognizesClaudeTui asserts internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go routes harness="claude-tui" to the claude-tui constructor and that diff against main shows no other service-side file changed.
4) TestHarnessImportsLintClaudeTui asserts internal/build/harnessimports passes and that no service*.go file imports internal/harnesses/claude-tui beyond the runner-constructor seam.
5) TestClaudeTuiRegistryEntry asserts the registry returns BaseArgs=nil/empty, PermissionArgs=nil/empty, ModelFlag="", ReasoningFlag="", WorkDirFlag="", IsSubscription=true, AutoRoutingEligible=false.
6) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
7) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
